items.text: Nameless bookmarks — bookmarks without a display name now show the site hostname in the grid (e.g. github.com) instead of a blank row. Hover or focus the row for the full URL in the tooltip.

Guided tours stay on track — while a config tab tour runs, the rest of the page is dimmed and non-interactive (tabs, Save, search, other fields). Only the highlighted step and the tour card accept clicks, so you cannot accidentally switch tabs mid-tour.
